safe_full_auto.allowed_when: legacy currentStage==PROLOGUE and no legacy BADGE_01..03 and no legacy S1/S2/S3 progression events

collection_preserving_story_reset.behavior: preserve creatures/dex/safe inventory/settings; reset story progress/currentStage to PROLOGUE; preserve original file as backup
collection_preserving_story_reset.reason: legacy S1~S3 order and badge semantics changed

manual_reconciliation.behavior: semantic mapping below may be used, but destination is not committed until progression gates validate

field_mappings.transform: copy legacy value; append migration warning that legacy time may include background time
distribute in order across BOX01..BOX10, 30 each; reject if >300
copy supported item IDs after alias conversion
apply capture ball aliases; never create geoje_ball from legacy guaranteed ball
copy only IDs valid in current event catalogs
apply item aliases; remove obsolete EXP Share claims
textSpeed/battleAnimations/reducedMotion/volume preserved; new fields use v2 defaults

dex_activation_transform.rule: sorted unique union(legacy caughtSpeciesNos, legacy researchRegisteredSpeciesNos, speciesNo from all creature instances)

creature_transform.exp_policy: legacy exp semantics were undefined; preserve level exactly and set totalExp=max(level^3, level^3 + max(0,legacyExp) only if legacyExp is explicitly marked within_level). Default migration uses level^3 and records partial-exp-reset warning.
creature_transform.nickname: preserve then revalidate with shared name validator
creature_transform.pp_policy: if legacy PP absent, initialize ppCurrent to current Battle v3 move max PP; otherwise clamp to current max PP
creature_transform.hp_policy: recalculate maxHP under Battle v3 and clamp legacy currentHp to [0,maxHP]
creature_transform.status_policy: preserve only valid v3 major status values; otherwise null
creature_transform.releaseProtected_default: true for starter/story-unique/legend/mythic/research-protected acquisition tags when detectable; otherwise false

onseom_ball.note: must NOT become geoje_ball; preserves 12-ball lifetime invariant

eco_share.reason: EXP Share removed in v1 final design

exp_share.reason: EXP Share removed in v1 final design

early_stage_semantic_aliases.policy: if any legacy early badge/progression event is present, safe_full_auto is blocked; never silently rewrite early progression

later_progression_policy.BADGE_04_to_08: same numeric IDs may be preserved after early reconciliation
later_progression_policy.S4_to_POST_currentStage: preserve only after early progression reconciliation passes
later_progression_policy.story_flags: copy only current Story Flags v2 IDs whose meaning is unchanged; unknown legacy flags are archived in migration.warnings and discarded from authoritative flags

geoje_ball_policy.reason: 거제볼은 current Story Flags v2 one-time grant ledger로만 발생하며 lifetime cap=12

champion_snapshot_policy.legacy_MAIN_STORY_CLEAR_without_snapshot: do not fabricate first-clear party/time; leave firstChampionClearSnapshot null and add migration warning
champion_snapshot_policy.certificate: may be regenerated from current state, but must not be presented as exact first-clear archive

migration_algorithm: 1. source schema/content versions 확인 및 원본 백업
2. safe_full_auto 가능 여부 검사; 초반 진행 흔적이 있으면 자동 commit 금지
4. creature instances 변환 후 party/PC 재배치
5. dex activatedSpeciesNos 재구축 및 seen 보정
6. Story Flags v2에 존재하는 안전한 flags/events만 변환
9. Save v2 invariants + geojeBall cap 검증
10. 검증 성공 시 선택한 user slot에 atomic import; 실패 시 원본/기존 slot 유지
